summary.en: VPN client with an Arm64 MSI (OpenVPN-2.7.9-I001-arm64.msi).
summary.zh-TW: VPN 用戶端，提供 Arm64 MSI 安裝檔（OpenVPN-2.7.9-I001-arm64.msi）。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: The tunnel driver must also work on Arm64; this was not tested here.
caveats.zh-TW: 通道驅動程式也須支援 Arm64，此處未實測。
